lead: Test build 0.8.22c (branch round-0.8.22, CI run 39048281922, version 0.8.22): every menu of the plug-in is now a window of its own on all systems, like the original's Windows menus: it may reach beyond the plug-in window and use the whole screen; the patch and bank menus are our own menus again on Windows and macOS too; a submenu opens or switches when the pointer rests on its entry for a moment (Windows' menu delay, 400 ms on macOS and Linux), so you can cross other entries into an open submenu. Plus everything from 0.8.22b (the complete REMOTE page). Already done: L3, L5 pass; the dev build passed a crash smoke test in REAPER. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Disposable DAW project only. No firmware or OS update, no "Burn To Flash", no factory reset, no storing patches (LOAD in the patch menus is fine, SAVE there is not).
On the REMOTE page SAVE is fine: it writes template files only (a new file "MY TEST.vrt" in Documents/Access Music/Virus TI/Remote Templates; delete it afterwards if you like).
Order this time: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows 11 VM, macOS last. Close the DAW before moving the Virus.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude unpacks the CI build to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22c-linux. Close REAPER, then in a terminal: cd ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22c-linux/TI-Revive-0.8.22-linux && sudo ./install.sh (replaces Claude's dev build in ~/.vst3).
notes: Results so far: L1, L2 FAIL (0.8.22a), L3 pass, L5 pass, L4 FAIL (0.8.22b: menus bound to the plug-in window, RAM A's patches switched on the way). L6 and L7 test the new menus.

items.title: Patch and bank menus as their own windows (redo of L4)
steps: Part 1: LOAD. Rest on the device entry, then on RAM A: its 128 patches. Move diagonally into the patches across RAM B and RAM C.
Rest on RAM B: the list switches. Then ROM A and Personal Libraries. Pick a patch from ROM A.
BROWSER: the upper bank bar's arrow, pick another bank.
items.expect: the menus may go beyond the plug-in window; submenus open next to their entry (on the left when there is no room on the right) and never cover their parent; crossing RAM B on the way keeps RAM A's patches; resting on an entry switches after a short moment; the patch loads; the browser shows the bank; the DAW does not crash.

items.title: Closing the menus, keys, value lists
steps: Open LOAD on part 1, then click on the desktop or another window: the menu closes. Open it again, click into the editor: it closes, and nothing in the editor changes.
Open LOAD, then switch to another application with Alt-Tab: the menu closes.
Open LOAD: Down, Right (opens the submenu), Left (closes it), Esc, Esc.
OSC page, oscillator 1 in Wavetable mode: right-click the table name; size menu (right-click an empty spot) to 200 %, open LOAD again, then back to 100 %.
items.expect: every way of closing works and the click that closes the menu changes nothing in the editor; keys work; the Wavetable list opens at once with 4 columns of 25 and the highlight follows without lag; at 200 % the menu sits at the LOAD button and keeps its normal size.

items.title: REMOTE page
steps: PATCH UTILITY > REMOTE. Single-click template 3 (it is only highlighted), then double-click it.
Click the Template Name field, type MY TEST, Return. Click knob VALUE 2, click the KNOB NAME field, type CUT, Return.
Arrow at the right end of MIDI STRING: Control Change > Volume (Ctrl 7) on Ch 1. Then set MIDI Channel Behaviour to Enable and back to Disable.
Close and reopen the plug-in window (or the DAW project).
items.expect: after the double-click the LCD shows "Remote Templates Selected Temp" and the template name; the list shows MY TEST at 3; the text fields fit their boxes while typing; VALUE 2's name CUT; MIDI STRING B0 07 * with the info line Control Change Ch 1, 7, Value above it; the channel menu changes; after reopening everything is still there; the Virus keeps playing normally.

items.title: REMOTE LOAD of a factory template
steps: Double-click template 7. LOAD > Personal Libraries > Remote Templates > Ableton > the template there (only if the Access software's templates are installed in the VM).
items.expect: template 7 gets that template's name and knob names; the Virus keeps playing.

items.title: REMOTE LOAD and SAVE
steps: Double-click template 5. LOAD: look through the places; pick a factory template (e.g. under Remote Templates > Ableton) if one is listed.
SAVE > Personal Remote Templates > Save as new Template..
Double-click template 6, LOAD > Personal Remote Templates > the file you just saved.
items.expect: LOAD lists the places that have templates (note which ones and whether the factory templates appear); the loaded template's name shows at 5; a new file named after template 5 appears; template 6 gets the same name.
